content.text:
# Pin the migrations dir to an absolute path so the app readiness check
# (which resolves it relative to the app server cwd) finds the checked-in
# Goose migrations regardless of where the dev server runs from.
MIGRATIONS_DIR=/workspace/packages/data/migrations

observation.command:
cd /workspace && printf '
# Pin the migrations dir to an absolute path so the app readiness check
# (which resolves it relative to the app server cwd) finds the checked-in
# Goose migrations regardless of where the dev server runs from.
MIGRATIONS_DIR=%s/packages/data/migrations
' "$(pwd)" >> config/runtime/base.vars
tail -4 config/runtime/base.vars
